items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: I do Vince Giordano replicating it a hundred years later and everything.

ctx.x: Because in class I just play his last five notes, and then we listen to the great solo of “Singing the Blues” by Bix. And then I do Vince Giordano replicating it a hundred years later and everything.
Why in your estimation are those records so different?
